name: Beef Birria Rice Bowls

components.name: Birria & Consommé

ingredients.name: Beef chuck roast, cut into large chunks
Dried guajillo chillies, stemmed and seeded (~70 g)
Dried ancho chillies, stemmed and seeded (~57 g)

steps: Salt beef chunks and sear them until well browned. Move into a deep braising pot.
De-stem and seed guajillo and ancho chillies. Simmer the dried chillies with onion, tomato and whole spices in some water for 10–15 minutes until softened.
Blend the softened chillies, vegetables and liquid with garlic, vinegar, cumin and oregano. Strain if a smooth broth is desired.
Pour sauce over beef, add enough water to cover partly, cover and simmer gently for about 3–4 hours until shreddable.
Lift beef from broth, shred, remove excess surface fat if preferred and moisten meat with some consommé.

components.name: Rice
steps: Cook rice near the end, then portion across eight meals with birria and a small measured serving of consommé.
Store coriander, diced onion and lime separately and add fresh after reheating.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Freezer: Birria beef and broth freeze very well.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
